howto.name: Upload a MOV file
howto.text: Drop a .mov file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools re-encodes via FFmpeg
howto.text: VP9 WebM is smaller than the MOV at comparable quality and needs no QuickTime.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. VP9 WebM is the right output for the open web: smaller than the MOV at comparable quality, and playable without QuickTime.

faq.a: WebM (VP9/Opus) is the open format for fast-loading HTML5 video and is well-supported in browsers. MOV→WebM always re-encodes because the codecs differ.
Usually yes — WebM/VP9 is efficient for the web and is often smaller than the source MOV at similar quality.
Yes — local FFmpeg on the PrivaTools backend; files removed after the response.
